description: This file defines the DoubleRange class which models numeric ranges with optional bounds, including methods for range containment checks, comparison, and string representation.
external_files: Format (likely a utility class or method for formatting numbers)

classes.name: DoubleRange
classes.description: Represents a bounded or unbounded numeric range with methods to access bounds, compare ranges, check containment, and generate string representations.

methods.name: DoubleRange
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes a range without bounds.

methods.name: DoubleRange
methods.description: Constructor initializing the range with specified low and high bounds, defaulting to infinite bounds if null.

methods.name: getHigh
methods.description: Returns the high bound of the range.

methods.name: setHigh
methods.description: Sets the high bound, defaulting to positive infinity if passed null.

methods.name: getLow
methods.description: Returns the low bound of the range.

methods.name: setLow
methods.description: Sets the low bound, defaulting to negative infinity if passed null.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this range to another based on low (ascending) and high (descending) bounds.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a given double value is within this range.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the range, indicating bounds.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another DoubleRange object based on bounds.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code consistent with equals, based on bounds.
